what_works: Near-black ground with a single saturated safety-orange accent and an oversized type-led hero — feels like industrial control software, not a service. For a pest-control company that wants to feel 'engineered,' this palette + scale pairing reads as competence, not aggression.
what_does_not_translate: The Webflow-built generative platform demos and animated loaders need real engineering hours — keep the orange-on-near-black palette and the big disciplined type, drop the demo widgets.
type_observations: Single heavy grotesk at huge clamp (display ~140px) + a tight mono-style accent for labels; only two weights total.
